issue.title: Mac CaptureDotRouteAliasTests fast-double-dot test records one capture-rewrite ask instead of two on some CI runs
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-kj.5 (notes #2-#4, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the
bob-cli-kj land agent. Not caused by bob-cli-kj, whose only bob-mac-capture commits
were the alias-ledger teardown isolation fix (1e83c03) and a docs trim (2007294). The
test came from e7ddfc6/e5b5889.

## What fails

`Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/CaptureDotRouteAliasTests.swift::testFastDoubleDotBeforeReplyCollapsesToOne`
fails at line 365 with `XCTAssertEqual(asks.count, 2)`: `("1") is not equal to ("2")`.

- FAIL: exact-SHA macOS CI run 43112612175 on 1e83c03 (bob-mac-capture master,
  2026-11-11).
- PASS: run 43117124821 on 7fceb52 (fully green, 4750 tests), 0.763 s, and on the
  other runs kj.5 inspected.

## Likely cause

This is the same shape as bob-cli-jb (`CaptureRelationEqualsAliasTests.testFastDoubleEqualsBeforeReplyCollapsesToOne`,
also `asks.count` 1 vs 2). The first draft's capture-rewrite ask is recorded only if
its Task launches fake-bob before the second key's probe cancels it, and on a loaded
CI runner it sometimes does not. The fix should match whatever jb adopts: wait for the
observable first ask, or count the cancelled request deterministically. Keep the
collapse-to-one and final-text assertions, and do not loosen production timing.

task_type_fields.evidence: FAIL run 43112612175 (1e83c03) at line 365, 1 vs 2 asks; PASS run 43117124821 (7fceb52) 0.763 s with the test file unchanged since e5b5889. 1 failure in 2+ observed CI runs; macOS-CI-only, not reproduced serially.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: bob-mac-capture macOS CI full suite (Scripts/macos-ci-check); swift test --filter CaptureDotRouteAliasTests

issue.creation_reason: A Mac alias test failed on one exact-SHA macOS CI run and passed on the next unchanged-test run, the same race shape as bob-cli-jb on a different node; proposed by bob-cli-kj.5 and triaged by the bob-cli-kj land agent.
